name: Radio button
statusNote: Geometry, color mapping and interaction model are identical to baseline M3. The only Expressive-era change is that the dot's grow/shrink now runs on a named spring instead of a duration curve, which is a framework-wide motion-system change, not specific to this component.
summary: A circular selection control for choosing exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set. Always used in groups of two or more; never used alone, and never has an indeterminate state.

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: Whether this radio button is the selected option in its group.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Called when this radio button is clicked. Omit to make it non-interactive; it still renders in its current visual state. The component has no group awareness: the caller must deselect the other members of the group itself.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Disables interaction and applies the disabled color when false.

anatomy.name: Outer ring
anatomy.description: A stroked circle, always drawn, in the unselected or selected color.

anatomy.name: Inner dot
anatomy.description: A filled circle shown only when selected, sharing the ring's color.

anatomy.name: State layer
anatomy.description: Circular hover/focus/pressed indicator centered on the control, extending past the ring and not clipped to it.

layout.text: The ring's diameter is icon-size; its stroke width is hard-coded to 2dp, not read from any token.
The ring is drawn stroked and inset by half its stroke width, so its visual edge sits exactly at the icon-size boundary.
The inner dot's resting radius is hard-coded to 6dp (12dp diameter). It is not derived from icon-size and has no backing token; author it as its own constant.
The dot is inset by the same stroke width as the ring (radius minus half the stroke width), so it never visually touches the ring's inner edge.
A hard-coded 2dp padding sits between the clickable/state-layer area and the ring, applied before the ring is measured at icon-size. No token backs this padding.
The state layer is unbounded and circular, radius state-layer-size / 2, and is not clipped to the ring's bounds.

states.text: Ring and dot both draw in selected-icon-color; the dot is shown.

states.label: unselected
states.text: Ring draws in unselected-icon-color; the dot is not shown (radius 0).
Colors snap immediately to the disabled set on either side of the enabled/disabled transition; there is no animation between enabled and disabled.

Hovering, focusing or pressing does not recolor the ring or dot: comp.radio-button defines per-interaction icon-color tokens (selected-hover-icon-color, unselected-focus-icon-color, etc.), but RadioButtonColors in the pinned Compose implementation exposes only four colors (selected, unselected, disabled-selected, disabled-unselected) and never reads them. Interaction feedback is the ripple/state-layer overlay only.

behaviour.text: Selecting animates the dot's radius from 0 to its resting 6dp on a fast-spatial spring.
Deselecting animates the same spring back to radius 0. Unlike checkbox, there is no snap/delay asymmetry between selecting and deselecting.
Ring and dot color transitions animate together, since they always share one resolved color per state, on a default-effects spring.
Selection is exclusive within a group: selecting one radio button must programmatically deselect the others in the same group. The component itself has no group awareness or shared state.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the group, not to each radio button individually.
Arrow keys move selection between options within a group and select the newly focused option immediately, unlike checkbox there is no separate Space-to-toggle step.
Space activates the focused option if none in the group is yet selected.
semantics: Exposed as part of a mutually exclusive group; assistive tech announces group position, e.g. "2 of 4".
Label text adjacent to the control should be included in the tap target, per group-list patterns.

notes.text: comp.radio-button defines per-interaction-state icon colors (selected-hover-icon-color, selected-focus-icon-color, selected-pressed-icon-color, and the unselected equivalents), but RadioButtonColors in the pinned Compose implementation only carries selectedColor/unselectedColor/disabledSelectedColor/disabledUnselectedColor and never branches on hover, focus or pressed. Those eight tokens are unread; interaction feedback is the ripple overlay alone.
The dot's fixed 6dp radius is a genuine gap in the token set: comp.radio-button has no dot-size token. Hardcode 6dp or promote it to a token; do not attempt to derive it from icon-size.
Ring and dot always share a single resolved color per state; there is no separate container-vs-icon color pairing like checkbox has. Do not introduce a second color for the dot.

No focus-indicator-color token exists for radio-button (unlike checkbox's comp.checkbox.focus-indicator-color, itself unread by Compose). Use the state layer plus the platform's default focus ring for focus indication; nothing in comp.radio-button governs it.
